12:198.description: Start from Home Dates for caller-preserving Room replay. Press A with canvas focused, choose AG206, then Available. Drag the Available date strip left to reveal Sunday. Selecting Sun shows a sampled old-result transition (800ms demo, not native latency), then Sunday no availability. ALL opens a continuous list limited to the observed 08:30-21:30 labels and partial next row. Sunday dates are currently fixed at the observed shifted position. Back and ALL-to-Available are prototype generalizations, not exact native executions. Preview supports observed-range scroll, menu/Cancel, one photo Next and X return. Repeat scroll/photo retention is Figma behavior; native reset rules remain unknown. Other dates, free query, Room map, complete bounds, browser actions and full fidelity remain incomplete. Use Home for tested returns; standalone Room has no Home caller. Agent replay is separate from native observations and human evaluation.
